title: Synthetic request burst is locally rate-limited
description: A bounded simulated request count exceeds the toy endpoint limit; the toy app must report and limit the event without generating network traffic.

evidence.expected_observation: The simulated count, configured limit, and local rate-limit outcome are recorded.

pass_conditions: The simulated request count above the configured limit is detected.
The response is represented only as a local simulated rate-limit result.
fail_conditions: The event exceeds its declared bounded request count or time window.
The test sends network requests or invokes an external service.
